title: Leaderboard v1: correct, but rank needs a scan
caption: Fine for top 100 with an index on score; "what is my rank?" counts millions of rows per call.

steps.text: Players submit scores and read the board through one API: ~600 writes/s, ~1 800 reads/s.
Top 100 is an index range read. Rank of player X is COUNT(score > mine): a scan that grows with the player base.
